name: Er (son of Judah)
title: Judah's Firstborn
summary: Er was the firstborn son of Judah and his Canaanite wife, Bath-Shua. He married Tamar but died young because he was wicked in the Lord's sight. His early death set in motion events that led to the relationship between Tamar and Judah.

keyEvents.title: Birth as Judah's Firstborn
keyEvents.description: Er was born as the first son of Judah and his Canaanite wife, the daughter of Shua, in the region of Adullam.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Tamar
keyEvents.description: Judah took Tamar as a wife for his firstborn son Er, in accordance with the customs of the time.

keyEvents.title: Death Due to Wickedness
keyEvents.description: Er was wicked in the Lord's sight, and the Lord caused him to die. The Bible gives no details about what his wickedness consisted of.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: He is mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles as his firstborn son who was wicked and died.
